title: Command router config (mpi-command-router)
description: Route external Bash command names through PATH wrappers. Unknown keys are rejected.

enabled.description: False disables routing without removing routes. Disabled routes must still be valid.

routes.description: Exact external command names mapped to executable plus fixed arguments. Original arguments are appended literally. $NAME and ${NAME} in a target or argument expand from the environment at load time; an unset name is rejected.

items.description: Executable name from the original PATH, or a path relative to the config directory. Absolute paths are accepted. $NAME and ${NAME} expand from the environment; $$ writes a literal dollar and any other ${ form is rejected.
